projectDescription: Husk is an AI-native financial operating system for growing European teams, offering corporate cards, expense management, real-time financial insights, and AI spend tracking — all in one platform.
keyFeatures: Instant corporate debit and charge cards via Stripe/Mastercard
WhatsApp receipt capture for zero-touch expense management
Real-time financial insights: burn rate, runway, cash flow
AI spend management with per-request cost breakdown and customer profitability
MCP integration — query finances from Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP client
Multi-bank visibility via PSD2 open banking
Integrations with Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Slack, Gusto, Wise, Navan
Dynamic credit without personal guarantees, powered by live business data
Global payments to 210 countries in 150+ currencies
Up to 1% cashback on card spend
publicApiSurface: Spending controls (vendor controls, category controls, per-card limits)
Financial dashboard (burn rate, runway, cash flow, multi-bank)
AI spend tracking (cost by provider, model, feature, customer)
MCP server endpoint for AI client integrations
Integrations: Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Slack, Gusto, Wise, Revolut Business, Navan
Cashback and FX fee structure per plan
